goal: Add a nullable boolean column has_talent_likeness to dam.style_guide_file recording whether the style-guide file's source explicitly indicated talent likeness, as a tri-state where NULL means the source exposed no determination. Structure only.
prohibited_actions: backfilling or otherwise writing any row value into has_talent_likeness; this intake authorizes structure only
inferring the value from a filename, path, folder or title
declaring the column NOT NULL or giving it a default, which would destroy the third NULL state
altering or repurposing the existing raw source filename and label columns (title, relative_path, folder, metadata)
running production DDL directly instead of through the governed promotion workflow
assumptions: The raw source filename and label remain preserved separately in the existing title, relative_path, folder and metadata columns, so no new column is needed to retain them.
NULL is a distinct third answer meaning the source exposed no determination, and is never to be read as FALSE.
stop_conditions: any repository guard or required check fails and passing it would require weakening or bypassing the guard
the work would require writing row data rather than structure
the correct value for the column cannot be determined from the source without inference
